items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: like Chuck and Gap Mangione in Rochester.

ctx.x: For me in my teens frankly I thought that’s the way the life was. And I mean I treated them with great respect. Of course I think now about how I behaved and I go oh my God. But no I mean I had no idea of how great it was.
Yeah. In some ways it’s great. I mean when I was in my teens I had a couple of experiences but they were a different level, like Chuck and Gap Mangione in Rochester.
